metadata.description: SYNTHETIC / HAND-AUTHORED PLACEHOLDER -- NOT live-captured; live .zip capture is explicitly HELD pending SFD feature-flag confirmation (see internal_app_create_zip.json's description for the full rationale, which applies identically here). GET /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId} for the placeholder zip app in that sibling fixture. DeploymentOptions/FilesOptions ARE populated here (unlike the pkg sibling fixture) because .zip's mandatory-field set includes them per vendored-test-apps/windows/SPEC.md section 9 -- FilesOptions.ApplicationUnInstallProcess shows UseCustomScript=true with a populated CustomScript, which is the one field that distinguishes zip's required metadata from msi's (msi's own get fixture shows UseCustomScript=false). The literal id 67007 is baked into the path (not the {applicationId} template) for the same RequestMatcher collision-avoidance reason documented throughout this directory tree. Relocated 2026-08-06 to internal/mockserver/testdata/synthetic-placeholders/ (Phase-3-surviving location -- see that directory's README.md) for use by TestGeneratedInternalAppsV1Lifecycle_ZIP via a bypass-only mock server. The original testdata/mock-responses/internal-apps-v1/zip/get_internal_app_zip.json copy is left in place, unmodified, for CI existence checks and any other still-passing consumer of the old testdata tree.
